newsitem.title: USA: Bullet Sports unit files Ch11 protection.
newsitem.headline: Bullet Sports unit files Ch11 protection.

text.p: Bullet Sports International Inc said Wednesday that its subsidiary and principal operating entity, Bullet-Cougar Golf Corp, has filed for bankruptcy protection.
The company said the entity filed for protection on January 17 in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Central District of California.

The company said Bullet-Cougar's secured loan with Deutsche Financial Services Corp has been bought by Clearwater Fund IV LLC, which has entered into a new loan agreement with Bullet-Cougar for $1 million.
The company said it is negotiating with Clearwater about additional debtor-in-possession financing but that no agreements have been reached.
